droplet-based scRNA-seq (3' scRNA-seq and 5' scRNA-seq) using the chromium platform (10x Genomics)

metadata.source_identity_policy: Exact original patient/timepoint source_name and title agree. CLL1 suffix pairs share patient/timepoint and all source clinical fields; grouped conservatively as dependent RNA views of one source patient/timepoint. Retain original GSMs and capture suffixes; no extra independent draws or exact same-day collection claim.
metadata.source_time_policy: Original clinical treatment/relapse/timepoint labels retained. No numeric interpolation across visit codes and no exact draw dates inferred. Patient-based longitudinal identifier does not establish temporal spacing.
metadata.source_transplant_policy: Post-RIC allogeneic transplantation samples retain source clinical context. Patient identifier is the recipient clinical unit; hematopoietic donor identity and mixed chimerism not assigned from RNA or assumed equal to pretransplant genotype.
metadata.source_annotation_policy: SCimilarity provides common cell-type labels, not validated malignant-clone or Richter-cell assignments. Source malignancy/therapy and cell-support uncertainty remain metadata; no clone/genotype analysis.
metadata.source_missingness_policy: Original N/A CD19/CD5 percentages retained as reported, never converted to zero. WBC original values retained; units not added from an unverified per-sample crosswalk.
metadata.source_demographic_policy: Primary table reports clinical Age without a per-draw reference date. Preserve as clinical age; do not assign unchanged exact draw age across longitudinal samples. Source M/F clinical patient sex retained, not a hematopoietic-donor or post-transplant-cell genotype inference.
metadata.source_scope_policy: Only original blood RNA. Related GSE163579 chromatin data, bone marrow RNA and lymph-node assays are not additional PBMC source samples.
metadata.split_assignment: unassigned; keep all visits and capture views of a patient in one future partition
metadata.source_gene_geometry_policy: Only original Gene Expression counts used for annotation, RNA QC and centroid normalization; explicitly typed CITE-seq antibody features excluded from RNA denominators. All original feature values still audited.

source_count_review.barcode_scope: Source matrix barcode rows; not automatically called or viable cells
